text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Agnes Digital has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Don't you think it's about time we set a date?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We've seen Umas laugh, we've seen Umas cry, all about a million times over by now. It's about time we build some new memories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What am I "talking about?!" I'm talking about our hot spring vacation! Remember the coupon we won at the start of this year?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You said after we finished our third year in the Twinkle Series, we could go and have a nonstop Uma talk session!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I haven't forgotten, of course. I suppose this is just about the perfect time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: W-wait. That's it? You'll go? …I mean, I'm happy and all, I just didn't expect such an instant "okay," but um…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: B-but this is you we're talking about! I'm sure we'll have plenty of stories to talk the night away. Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what she's nervous about this time, but we end up taking a train to the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gulp… Chatting… just the two of us…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It'll be okay. Of course it'll be okay… Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle, rattle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Heeeeere's Digitan! Now let's get this heated Uma debate started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I settle in for a chat with a frighteningly passionate Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! That's so true! Hehe, the clumsy way Doto made her move..

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about it makes me… Drool… Which reminds me—
choice_data_list: Um, don't you think it's about time we get some food?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Food? We haven't moved onto that topic yet.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh, wow! It's dinner time already?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Time really flew by there, right?! It's like it was stolen from right under our noses…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, Digital! Look at how you lost yourself in that chat…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I knew I was just worrying over nothing. There was never any reason to be scared…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some hesitation, Agnes Digital continues.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even though we have so much in common, I couldn't help but get a little nervous. I mean, it's a hot spring trip…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Like, what if we found out we're into different types of waifu, and then it gets all awkward and quiet?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: As soon as I started worrying about that, my social skills went out the window…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But still! Once we got yapping, it's like I couldn't stop! We're not even close to covering everything.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you know how rare and miraculous this is? How exhilarating?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I never thought this day would come. Y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Finally… I found someone I can really relate to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Agnes Digital was worried we'd run out of things to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-wh-where is that line from?! I don't think I've seen that movie!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Busting a line out like that like it's nothing… Talk about a silver tongue…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But if that's how you are, I get the feeling we've got a lot more to talk about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, we resume our enjoyable conversation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh… That was when I debuted, right? It def was! You remember, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ew, ew, ew! Pleeease forget you ever saw that! That was a dark moment, and some things aren't meant to be remembered!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …When did the conversation switch from Umamusume to me? And why?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Why is the conversation still going on like it's perfectly normal? Have I transformed into some kinda social butterfly or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I totally have! For sure! I used to be a superfan that lived and breathed Umamusume. It's the only thing I could talk about…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But now it's like… whatever. Anything is okay. And if you're okay with me as I actually am…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! I can't stop talking about myself! There's so much I wanna tell you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Agnes Digital's personal stories start flooding out as if from a broken dam. She's never opened up like this before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Agnes Digital and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during this time together.
